title: The Shared Password
story:
The class project was due on Friday, and four students shared one online folder. Hana created it on Monday and chose a password so only the group could open it. She wrote the password on a note for each partner. The secret word was riverlamp, because the teacher had warned them not to use easy words like password or a birthday.

On Wednesday evening Tom could not get in. He typed riverlamp three times, but the screen said it was wrong. He sent a message to the group. Hana checked her note and saw the problem. Priya had changed the password that afternoon so she could add a video, but she had forgotten to tell the others. The new password was riverlamp7.

Priya felt embarrassed and apologised in the chat. She put the new password in a pinned note at the top of their messages, where nobody would miss it. She also said they should not write passwords on paper that might be lost. Their teacher had shown them how to invite people by school email instead.

The group fixed the folder before dinner. Tom added his charts, and Hana added the introduction. On Thursday they met in the library and checked every page. After that, Hana removed the shared password and sent each partner a personal invite. Nobody wanted another locked folder the night before the deadline.
